notices.short_title: CAPA REGULATORY AGENDA FY 2027 BUSINESS INTEGRITY COMMISSION
notices.plain: The Business Integrity Commission has published its regulatory agenda for fiscal year 2027, which lists the rules it plans to propose or adopt, in an April 27, 2026 notice.

notices.short_title: INSTALLATION OF COLD FLUID APPLIED REINFORCED MEMBRANE ROOFING SYSTEM
notices.plain: The Department of Design and Construction is seeking qualified contractors, through a request for qualifications, to install a cold fluid applied reinforced membrane roofing system, with responses due Dec. 31, 2040.
The Department of Design and Construction is seeking qualified contractors for emergency water main work, with responses due Dec. 31, 2040.

notices.short_title: Reconstruction and Restoration of Landmarked and Landmark-Quality Buildings
notices.plain: The Department of Design and Construction is seeking qualified contractors for reconstruction and restoration of landmarked and landmark-quality buildings, through a Request for Qualifications with responses due Dec. 31, 2040.

The Department of Design and Construction is seeking qualified general construction firms, including certified minority- and women-owned businesses, for small projects, with responses due Dec. 31, 2040.
The Department of Design and Construction is seeking qualified general construction firms for large projects, with responses due Dec. 31, 2040.
The Department of Design and Construction is seeking qualified general construction firms for medium-sized projects, with responses due Dec. 31, 2040, under a Request for Qualifications.

notices.short_title: Installation of Styrene-Butadiene-Styrene (SBS) Modified Bitumen Roofing System
notices.plain: The Department of Design and Construction is seeking bids from contractors for installing a styrene-butadiene-styrene modified bitumen roofing system, using a request for qualifications, with responses due Dec. 31, 2040.
The Department of Design and Construction is seeking qualifications from contractors for emergency sewer work, with responses due Dec. 31, 2040.

notices.short_title: MAINTENANCE AND REPAIR OF ACCESS CONTROL AND CCT
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection awarded T R Joy & Associates Inc a $536,867 renewal contract for maintenance and repair of access control and CCT systems.
The Department of Environmental Protection awarded Paul Bunyon Tree Care, Inc. a renewal of its landscaping services contract for $812,533.

notices.short_title: BEDC-WI-298-CM: Construction Management Services for Conversion of SHARON to Deammonification Process at Wards Island Wastewater Resource Recovery Facility
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection awarded Henningson Durham & Richardson PC a $8.4 million contract, chosen from competing proposals, for construction management services to convert the SHARON process to deammonification at the Wards Island Wastewater Resource Recovery Facility.

notices.short_title: BWSO_MVO-307: PREVENTIVE MAINTENANCE AND REPAIR OF VALVES AND ASSOCIATED OPERATING SYSTEMS AND EQUIPMENT IN DEP FACILITIES AND SUBTERRANEAN CHAMBERS OF CITY WATER TUNNEL #3
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection is seeking sealed bids, with the lowest qualified bid winning, for preventive maintenance and repair of valves and related operating systems and equipment at its facilities and in City Water Tunnel No. 3, with responses due May 26, 2026.

The Fire Department awarded Savant Financial Technologies Inc. a $75,399 contract for Dataminr First Alert licenses through a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business, made without competition.

notices.short_title: On-Call Collection and Disposal of Furniture, Office Equipment, and Laboratory Equipment
notices.plain: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene awarded RJV Office Furnishing LLC a $1.5 million contract, without competitive bidding, for on-call collection and disposal of furniture, office equipment and laboratory equipment.

notices.short_title: SMPD_PS_RFP 518099_An Enterprise-Wide Learning Management System and Performance Management Software Solution
notices.plain: The New York City Housing Authority is seeking proposals from vendors for an enterprise-wide learning management system and performance management software solution, with responses due June 2, 2026.

notices.short_title: Electrical Hazard Awareness Training (EHAT) & Aerial Rescue Training for NYC Parks
notices.plain: The Department of Parks and Recreation awarded Noble Oak LLC a $39,900 contract for electrical hazard awareness and aerial rescue training for New York City Parks staff.
The Department of Sanitation is seeking bids for X-rays with interpretations, with the lowest qualified bid to win, and responses are due May 20, 2026.
The School Construction Authority is seeking information from vendors, through a Request for Information, for a pedagogical strategic master plan, with responses due May 15, 2026.

The Department of Youth and Community Development awarded TCK Education Consultants LLC a $453,481 contract for a CRED/AGVEP assessment, using a noncompetitive small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business.
